title: Bản đồ & la bàn
concept: A bold cream compass ring enclosing an abstract S-shaped trail inspired by Vietnam, one tiny gold destination star. Strong simple silhouette.

title: Chìa khóa mật mã
concept: A single distinctive golden key whose bow is a simple five-petal lotus, with a teal keyhole in its center. Clear friendly puzzle adventure symbol.

title: Sổ tay khám phá
concept: A simple open cream travel notebook with a continuous teal S-shaped route flowing across its two pages, ending at one gold map pin. Thick contours, few elements.

title: Trống đồng
concept: A very simplified Dong Son bronze drum emblem: large central gold sun star and only two concentric bold geometric rings, deep teal negative space. Respectful Vietnamese cultural motif.

title: Sen định vị
concept: A warm gold lotus blossom fused naturally into a teal map location pin. Three bold petals only, powerful small-size silhouette.

title: Tem hành trình
concept: A cream travel postage stamp icon with a bold teal S-shaped route and one gold star, subtly scalloped outer edge, only three graphic elements.

title: Rương thẻ bí mật
concept: A friendly compact teal treasure chest, slightly open, with one cream collectible card and a gold star peeking out. Flat geometric logo symbol, no intricate decoration.

title: Kính lúp khám phá
concept: A bold cream magnifying glass enclosing a small gold five-point star and a short teal winding path. Minimal curious exploration game logo, no map borders.

title: Rồng chữ S
concept: A friendly stylized Vietnamese dragon forming one elegant S-shaped emblem, teal body and a tiny warm-gold crest. Two simple curved shapes, no scales or elaborate ornaments.

title: Cửa di sản
concept: A simple cream arched Vietnamese heritage gateway with teal opening shaped like a keyhole and one gold star above. Bold geometric adventure symbol, no pagoda clutter.
